info.name: Orbitly LMS API
info.description:
Every Orbitly API area with dummy data.

**Run it:** import this collection and `Orbitly-Local.postman_environment.json`, start the API, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`). Folder 00 registers a brand-new organization each run, so nothing touches your real data. Ids and tokens are saved as collection variables as the run goes.

**Roles:** requests authenticate as `admin`, `instructor` or `student` using `{{adminToken}}`, `{{instructorToken}}` and `{{studentToken}}`.

Full reference: `backend/docs/API.md` and Swagger UI at `/api/docs/ui`.

item.name: 00 · Setup
item.description: Creates a fresh organization for this run, so the collection never touches real data. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner) — later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

request.description: Liveness of the API, database and migrations.
Creates the organization and its first ADMIN. Saves `adminToken`, `orgSlug`, `orgId`.

item.name: 01 · Auth & account
item.description: Login, token refresh, profile and password flows.

request.description: Refresh tokens are single-use: replaying an old one revokes every session.
Always 202. With MAIL_MODE=log the reset link is printed in the API log.

item.name: 02 · People & invites (admin)
item.description: Invite an instructor, accept the invite, and let a student sign up.

exec: pm.test("invite is for an instructor", () => pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("INSTRUCTOR"));

item.name: 03 · Catalog & authoring
item.description: An admin creates a category; the instructor builds and publishes a free course (video, reading, quiz, assignment) and a paid one.

item.name: 10 · Media & resources
item.description: Signed upload flow (create → PUT bytes → complete) and course resources.

request.description: PUTs the bytes to the signed `uploadUrl` returned by *Create upload* (local disk in development, S3/R2 in production). In Postman you can switch the body to *binary* and pick a real image.
